historical_commentary.text: This is an ACI Technical Support FAQ roundup covering common 1997-era questions across the entire 4D 3.x/6.0 product family, including V6 conversion and early web issues; as a snapshot of support hot-topics of the moment it is now purely of historical/archival interest, since the specific products, conversion pitfalls, and terminology it addresses (Procedures/Phases, binary structure files, 4D SQL Server as a separate product) no longer describe current 4D.
related_updates: Most named companion products (4D Write, 4D Draw, 4D Calc, 4D Insider, 4D Open, DLL Tools) have been discontinued or absorbed/replaced by later 4D technology (e.g. 4D Write replaced by 4D Write Pro in 2016)
The 4D V6 conversion issues referenced predate decades of subsequent structure-file format evolution and the introduction of Project Mode (v17, 2018)
4D's SQL engine today (introduced in 4D v11 SQL, ~2007) is unrelated to the 'Optimization Issues'/older SQL Server product referenced here
